The '''Milarian system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Trans-Nebular sector/Legends|Trans-Nebular sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Milarian]].
